runtime dossier substitution changes both authority-request identity and digest
offered alternatives derive exactly from the qualified dossier and a gate decision must bind one exact request alternative

hard cycles, self edges, duplicate endpoints, duplicate sequences, unknown kinds, and incomplete canonical specs are rejected
consumer, interaction, and advisory relationships are rendered as non-blocking context, never completed prerequisites
safety-bearing historical completion cannot be reconstructed without its original conformance run
unauthenticated cancel or suspend is refused for safety-bearing turns
unreleased predecessor-generation admissions fence successor execution
restart JSON round-trip preserves specification bytes, qualification predicates, and canonical proposal digest

a goal gate request's authority scope is the installation governance scope and its subject scope is exactly the Goal generation; neither may stand in for the other, and a goal-scoped, foreign-installation, or subject-mismatched gate request cannot be persisted

a goal gate decision is valid only from the installation owner under the current installation root generation; other installation owners, model/agent principals, foreign or subject scopes, forged or unknown root generations, unoffered alternatives, missing ceremony evidence, and wrong request digests are each rejected at persistence

the supported interactive owner ceremony decides a generated gate request end to end (canonical root, qualified DOS evidence, gate request, interactive decision with exact alternative, durable decision, gate completion) and rejects wrong OS user, wrong request, wrong alternative, wrong dossier, replay and substitution
goals-lifecycle decide and non-interactive callers cannot record a gate decision

continuation acceptance, continuation attachment, and continuation request creation enforce the same activation predicate as direct accept/attach/request, refuse identical errors under removed, skewed, unset, and process-image-skewed activation, and leave no partial durable state
safety-bearing proposal, review, request, decision, acceptance, and attachment persistence refuse with no verifier or a refusing verifier regardless of calling path
restart never lifts an activation refusal; only restored activation completes the deterministic remainder
an accepted safety-bearing plan validates only through the two sanctioned provenance rewrites; proposal-time specifications stay exact
gate request persistence is idempotent across turns and restarts and a conflicting request under the same identity is refused

a safety-bearing plan can never carry supplied completed state at proposal, acceptance, attachment or overlay; completion derives only from qualified, specification-bound, profile-bound ledger evidence
generic baseline persistence (Save, Import, Finalize, establish) refuses any safety-bearing WorkPlan; it enters only through the authenticated attachment transaction

legacy acceptance cannot admit a safety-bearing WorkPlan; protected decisions must resolve a durable owner-ceremony record that matches the decision field for field, and an arbitrary or reused ceremony digest is refused

governing WorkPlan authority is re-verified (unrevoked decision, exact lineage, owner under an unrevoked generation, resolvable ceremony, baseline equal to the persisted generation) at every turn, gate reconciliation and completion; historical evidence stays readable

a missing, non-executable, changed or dirtying validator fails closed at every stage; validation runs are bound to the exact checkpoint and profile digest before and after execution; candidate conformance is decided before publication; no-declared-validation can never qualify a safety-bearing checkpoint or completion

activation verification binds to the executable image the process actually loaded and to the manifest path's current file; replacing the pathname while a process runs makes that process refuse protected work
the native runtime is built by the same constructors as the lifecycle commands and resolves activation and the selected goals package at every protected boundary, never from a startup snapshot
safety-bearing dossiers, gate contracts, specifications and activation manifests must parse as exactly one bounded value with no trailing content or duplicate keys
an authority-gate objective reaches gate coordination and never a provider from selection, explicit, recovered or pinned routes, and the provider resolver itself refuses it

a Goal classified safety-bearing by authenticated state cannot receive any WorkPlan through a generic surface, cannot admit a legacy proposal/review/acceptance/attachment, and cannot drive a generation that lacks the safety binding
kernel-shaped plan content (kinds, preserved specification bytes, gate provenance) without the safety binding is refused at proposal and accepted-plan validation, whichever tell remains

a ledger completion counts only with an authenticated seal for its exact bytes and Goal generation; a gate completion additionally re-resolves its request, decision, dossier and ceremony; a revoked or rejected decision demotes the completion (and hard dependents) to history without erasing it
the Goal completion candidate shown for settlement must equal the authenticated effective completions
an explicit, pinned or recovered objective must be an open, currently runnable candidate of the accepted plan

every outward effect (checkpoint publication, unit completion, gate completion) re-establishes activation, governing authority, lease and content binding before it; a failure after publication is recorded as published-but-ungoverned

validation runs against an exact export of the checkpoint commit; index hints, status, excludes, fsmonitor, hooks and replace refs in the worker checkout cannot substitute bytes; publication pushes the exact object id
validator output beyond the bound fails closed even with exit 0; the process tree is terminated after the validator returns

semantic duplicate JSON keys (case variants, Kelvin sign, long s), invalid UTF-8, unpaired surrogate escapes, trailing values and depth bombs are refused for safety-bearing evidence and external inputs

on darwin the running executable's kernel code-directory hash must equal a CodeDirectory of the file whose bytes the manifest binds, with every code page re-hashed; in-place overwrite and a replacement between exec and package initialization are refused

deleting any single sealed row, or any set of rows, never restores a revoked decision, a superseded or invalidated authority generation, or a superseded installation root: a decision or generation grants nothing unless its sealed liveness record is present, revocation/invalidation/succession retire that record, and it is written in the same transaction as the fact it keeps alive

deleting the Goal classification row cannot un-classify a Goal while any safety-bearing proposal or accepted-plan generation of it survives; an unreadable candidate row is an error, never 'unclassified'

an identical resubmission of a stored decision never recreates a retired liveness record; a revoked decision whose revocation row was deleted is not eligible for an ordinary re-request; publication and recovery admission require liveness as well as absence of revocation

governance state is consumable only when its authenticated fact chain is exactly the chain the forward authority anchor pins outside the store: a store restored whole or in part, replayed row by row, truncated, erased, forked, unrelated, or compared against a missing, unreadable, corrupt, foreign, stale or unavailable anchor yields no governance, never an older governance (I13)

a retirement (decision, generation, supersession) and a Goal's entry into the governed safety domain are anchored facts written ahead of their effects; a crash leaves either a consistent state or a fail-closed stranded state, never one that broadens permission

a Goal that entered the governed safety domain cannot become indistinguishable from a legacy one by deleting, truncating or rolling back evidence: the anchored classification fact survives every deletion of every evidence row, and every evidence kind is consumed by a registry that a coverage test forces to be complete (I14)

a governed re-anchor voids every admission made before it, re-admits only the installation root the owner attested, and can add restrictions but grant nothing; a decision that was in force in a restored backup and retired in the lost interval is not current
a protected request whose referenced proposal is missing fails closed instead of passing without an activation check
